# Setting up environment for Spatial Analysis

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 1024^3 * 10) # 10 GB
all_times <- list()  # store the time for each chunk
knitr::knit_hooks$set(time_it = local({
  now <- NULL
  function(before, options) {
    if (before) {
      now <<- Sys.time()
    } else {
      res <- difftime(Sys.time(), now, units = "secs")
      all_times[[options$label]] <<- res
    }
  }
}))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  tidy = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  time_it = TRUE,
  error = TRUE,
  dpi=150
)
```

# Dimensionality reduction, clustering

```{r dim.cluster}
GBM <- RunPCA(GBM, assay = "SCT", verbose = FALSE)
GBM <- FindNeighbors(GBM, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
GBM <- FindClusters(GBM, verbose = FALSE)
GBM <- RunUMAP(GBM, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
```

# Searching for features exhibiting spatial patterning in the absence of pre-annotation
 
Using two methods

## Moran's I Algorithm

```{r spatial.vf.moransi}
GBM <- FindSpatiallyVariableFeatures(GBM,
                                       features = VariableFeatures(GBM)[1:1000],
                                       selection.method = "moransi")
```

```{r spatial.vf.moransi.data.plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# With data

top.features <- head(SpatiallyVariableFeatures(GBM, method = "moransi"), 6)

SpatialFeaturePlot(
  GBM,
  features = top.features,
  images = NULL,
  crop = TRUE,
  slot = "data",
  keep.scale = "feature",
  min.cutoff = NA,
  max.cutoff = NA,
  ncol = 3,
  combine = TRUE,
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  alpha = c(2, 2),
  image.alpha = 2,
  image.scale = "lowres",
  shape = 21,
  stroke = NA,
  stroke.alpha = NA,
  interactive = FALSE,
  information = NULL,
  plot_segmentations = TRUE
) & 
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))
```

'''

Interestingly, Clusters 15, 11, 13, 6, 3, 16, 12 have a common base of overly expressed group of genes (could they be actually way more similar than expected and therefore PCA is overclustering?)

'''

```{r spatial.vf.mark}
GBM <- FindSpatiallyVariableFeatures(GBM,
```


# Inspecting clusters and finding their TOP markers to study patterns

```{r}
table(Idents(GBM))
```

```{r}
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  GBM,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
```

## 10 Top Genes per cluster

```{r}
library(dplyr)

top10 <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(
    order_by = avg_log2FC,
    n = 10
  )

top10
```

```{r heatmap, fig.width=16, fig.height=14, dpi=200, fig.align="center", message=FALSE}
top5 <- top10 %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

residual_limit <- 2.5

p_heatmap <- DoHeatmap(
  GBM,
  features = unique(top5$gene),
  assay = "SCT",
  slot = "scale.data",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  disp.min = -residual_limit,
  disp.max = residual_limit,
  angle = 90,
  hjust = 0,
  vjust = 0.5,
  size = 3.4,
  group.bar.height = 0.015,
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]] +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#313695", "#74ADD1", "#F7F7F7", "#F46D43", "#A50026"),
    limits = c(-residual_limit, residual_limit),
    breaks = c(-residual_limit, 0, residual_limit),
    na.value = "white",
    name = "SCT residual"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Marker genes across glioblastoma spot clusters",
    subtitle = "Up to five markers per cluster, ranked by average log2 fold change",
    caption = "Each column represents one Cell Cluster."
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "#263238"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(14, "mm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 19, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 6, 8)
  )

p_heatmap + ggplot2::guides(colour = "none")
```
# Possible correlation
## Identification of Spatially Variable Features using Seurat

Perform differential expression based on pre-annotated anatomical regions within the tissue, which may be determined either from unsupervised clustering or prior knowledge.

Cluster 5 and 9 have 'COL' type genes overly expressed when compared to all other clusters

```{r}
avg_sct_residuals <- as.matrix(
  AverageExpression(
    GBM,
    assays = "SCT",
    group.by = "seurat_clusters",
    layer = "scale.data"
  )$SCT
)

rho <- cor(avg_sct_residuals, method = "spearman")
cor_5_9 <- rho["g5", "g9"]

matches_5 <- sort(
  rho["g5", colnames(rho) != "g5"],
  decreasing = TRUE
)

data.frame(
  rank = seq_along(matches_5),
  cluster = sub("^g", "", names(matches_5)),
  spearman_rho = round(unname(matches_5), 3)
)

pair <- avg_sct_residuals[, c("g5", "g9")]
limits <- range(pair)

plot(
  pair[, "g5"], pair[, "g9"],
  xlim = limits, ylim = limits, asp = 1,
  pch = 16, cex = 0.55,
  col = adjustcolor("#176C72", alpha.f = 0.4),
  xlab = "Cluster 5 mean SCT residual",
  ylab = "Cluster 9 mean SCT residual",
  main = sprintf("Clusters 5 and 9 (Spearman rho = %.3f)", cor_5_9)
)
abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "grey55")

```

## Mapping the clusters and gene programms

This highlights clusters 5 (Collagen), 9 (Collagen) and 7 (Hypoxia) on the same H&E image.

```{r}
focus <- c("5", "9", "7")
cluster <- as.character(GBM$seurat_clusters)
GBM$focus_region <- factor(
  ifelse(cluster %in% focus, cluster, "Other"),
  levels = c(focus, "Other")
)

p_clusters <- SpatialDimPlot(
  GBM,
  group.by = "focus_region",
  pt.size.factor = 2.8,
  alpha = 1,
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  cols = c(
    "5" = "#D55E00",
    "9" = "#009E73",
    "7" = "#0072B2",
    "Other" = "grey88"
  ),
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]]

panels <- list(
  Collagen = c("COL1A1", "COL1A2", "COL3A1", "COL6A3"),
  GBM_markers = c("BCAN", "PTPRZ1", "DDR1"),
  Hypoxia = c("CA12", "HILPDA", "ANGPTL4", "CA9", "VEGFA"),
  MES1_markers = c("CHI3L1", "CD44", "ANXA2"),
  MES2_markers = c("ADM", "LDHA", "DDIT3")
)

panels <- lapply(panels, intersect, y = rownames(GBM[["SCT"]]))
print(panels)

GBM <- AddModuleScore(
  GBM, features = panels, assay = "SCT", name = "Niche", seed = 42
)
GBM$Collagen <- GBM$Niche1
GBM$GBM_markers <- GBM$Niche2
GBM$Hypoxia <- GBM$Niche3
GBM$MES1_markers <- GBM$Niche4
GBM$MES2_markers <- GBM$Niche5

score_maps <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  GBM,
  features = c(
    "Collagen", "Hypoxia",
    "MES1_markers", "MES2_markers",
    "GBM_markers"
  ),
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  alpha = c(1, 1),
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  keep.scale = "feature",
  combine = FALSE
)
```

```{r gbm-spatial-output, fig.width=14, fig.height=10, out.width="100%", fig.align="center"}
## Not a must, just making the graphs more readble
p_clusters <- p_clusters +
  ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 6, alpha = 1)
    )
  )

score_maps <- lapply(score_maps, function(p) {
  fill_scale <- p$scales$get_scales("fill")
  fill_scale$breaks <- scales::breaks_extended(n = 3)

  p + ggplot2::guides(
    fill = ggplot2::guide_colourbar(

        legend.key.height = grid::unit(3, "mm"),
        legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10)
      )
    )
  )
})

## Plotting

p_spatial <- wrap_plots(
  c(list(p_clusters), score_maps),

) & ggplot2::theme(

p_spatial
```

## Comparing Clusters highly expression MBP

```{r}
avg_expr <- AverageExpression(
  GBM,
  assays = "SCT",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  layer = "scale.data"
)$SCT

clusters_to_compare <- c(
  "g1", "g10", "g14", "g17",
  "g8", "g12", "g16"
)

avg_expr_subset <- as.matrix(
  avg_expr[, clusters_to_compare, drop = FALSE]
)

cor_matrix <- cor(
  avg_expr_subset,
  method = "spearman"
)

round(cor_matrix, 3)

library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  cor_matrix,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  main = "Transcriptional correlation between clusters"
)
```


```{r}
cor_pairs <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix))

cor_pairs <- cor_pairs %>%
  filter(Var1 != Var2) %>%
  mutate(
    pair = paste(
      pmin(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
      pmax(as.character(Var1), as.character(Var2)),
      sep = " vs "
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(pair, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(Freq))

cor_pairs
```


```{r myelin-clusters-1-14, fig.width=15, fig.height=10, fig.align="center"}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

gbm_myelin <- GBM
DefaultAssay(gbm_myelin) <- "SCT"

support_genes <- c("PLP1", "MOG", "MOBP")
genes <- c("MBP", support_genes)

missing_genes <- setdiff(genes, rownames(gbm_myelin[["SCT"]]))
if (length(missing_genes) > 0) {
  stop("Genes missing from the SCT assay: ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))
}

cluster_ids <- as.character(gbm_myelin$seurat_clusters)
gbm_myelin$myelin_region <- factor(
  ifelse(cluster_ids %in% c("1", "14"), paste("Cluster", cluster_ids), "Other spots"),
  levels = c("Cluster 1", "Cluster 14", "Other spots")
)

gbm_myelin <- AddModuleScore(
  gbm_myelin,
  features = list(support_genes),
  assay = "SCT",
  name = "MyelinCheck",
  seed = 42
)

image_id <- Images(gbm_myelin)[1]

p_clusters <- SpatialDimPlot(
  gbm_myelin,
  group.by = "myelin_region",
  images = image_id,
  image.scale = "lowres",
  cols = c(
    "Cluster 1" = "#D55E00",
    "Cluster 14" = "#0072B2",
    "Other spots" = "#D9D9D9"
  ),
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]] + ggtitle("Clusters 1 and 14")

marker_maps <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  gbm_myelin,
  features = c(genes, "MyelinCheck1"),
  slot = "data",
  images = image_id,
  image.scale = "lowres",
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  keep.scale = "feature",
  combine = FALSE
)

score_panel <- length(marker_maps)
marker_maps[[score_panel]] <- marker_maps[[score_panel]] +
  ggtitle("Myelin score excluding MBP")

p_myelin <- wrap_plots(c(list(p_clusters), marker_maps), ncol = 3) &
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 4),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold")
  )

p_myelin

spot_data <- FetchData(
  gbm_myelin,
  vars = c("myelin_region", genes, "MyelinCheck1"),
  layer = "data"
)

spot_data %>%
  group_by(myelin_region) %>%
  summarise(
    spots = n(),
    across(all_of(genes), mean, .names = "mean_{.col}"),
    median_myelin_score = median(MyelinCheck1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
mbp_spots <- FetchData(
  gbm_myelin,
  vars = c("seurat_clusters", "MBP", "MyelinCheck1", "nCount_Spatial"),
  layer = "data"
)

focus <- c("1", "14")
mbp_cutoff <- quantile(mbp_spots$MBP, 0.80, names = FALSE)

mbp_spots$cluster <- as.character(mbp_spots$seurat_clusters)
mbp_spots$mbp_high <- mbp_spots$MBP > 0 & mbp_spots$MBP >= mbp_cutoff

mbp_summary <- mbp_spots %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    spots = n(),
    high_spots = sum(mbp_high),
    pct_high = round(100 * mean(mbp_high), 1),
    median_MBP_high = median(MBP[mbp_high]),
    median_myelin_high = median(MyelinCheck1[mbp_high]),
    median_UMIs_high = median(nCount_Spatial[mbp_high]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_high))

print(mbp_summary, n = Inf)
```


```{r}
# Mapping high spots in clusters 1, 14 and the rest of the section.
mbp_colours <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#D55E00",
  "Cluster 14" = "#0072B2",
  "Other MBP-high" = "#756BB1",
  "Below cutoff" = "#D9D9D9"
)

mbp_spots$mbp_region <- factor(
  case_when(
    !mbp_spots$mbp_high ~ "Below cutoff",
    mbp_spots$cluster %in% focus ~ paste("Cluster", mbp_spots$cluster),
    TRUE ~ "Other MBP-high"
  ),
  levels = names(mbp_colours)
)

gbm_mbp_map <- AddMetaData(gbm_myelin, metadata = mbp_spots["mbp_region"])

p_mbp_map <- SpatialDimPlot(
  gbm_mbp_map,
  group.by = "mbp_region",
  images = Images(gbm_mbp_map)[1],
  image.scale = "lowres",
  cols = mbp_colours,
  pt.size.factor = 2.5,
  image.alpha = 0.55,
  combine = FALSE
)[[1]] +
  labs(title = "MBP-high spots on H&E", fill = NULL) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

# Comparing the score in clusters with enough high spots to show a distribution.
plot_clusters <- mbp_summary %>%
  filter(high_spots >= 20 | cluster %in% focus) %>%
  pull(cluster)

p_mbp_compare <- mbp_spots %>%
  filter(mbp_high, cluster %in% plot_clusters) %>%
  mutate(cluster = factor(cluster, levels = plot_clusters)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(cluster, MyelinCheck1, fill = mbp_region)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.alpha = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mbp_colours, guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "Myelin score among MBP-high spots",
    x = "Seurat cluster",
    y = "PLP1 / MOG / MOBP score"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

p_mbp_map + p_mbp_compare
```

From the looks of it, cluster 12 demonstrates particularly similar Myelin scores among MBP-high spots and interestingly, at a fairly further region than cluster 1 and 14. 

Posteriorly I will investigate what is the major difference between these two areas that drive the correlation score between them to be

0.45725566	(g1 vs g12)
0.43404108	(g12 vs g14)

Particularly when compared to the similarity if g1 vs g14 

0.94376386	(g1 vs g14)

```{r}
library(dplyr)

clusters <- c("1", "14", "12")
myelin_genes <- c("MBP", "PLP1", "MOG", "MOBP")

sct_residuals <- SeuratObject::LayerData(
  gbm_myelin, assay = "SCT", layer = "scale.data"
)

cluster_by_spot <- setNames(
  as.character(gbm_myelin$seurat_clusters),
  colnames(gbm_myelin)
)

spots_by_cluster <- split(
  colnames(sct_residuals),
  factor(cluster_by_spot[colnames(sct_residuals)], levels = clusters)
)

mbp_high_spots <- rownames(mbp_spots)[which(mbp_spots$mbp_high)]

data.frame(
  cluster = clusters,
  all_spots = lengths(spots_by_cluster),
  MBP_high_spots = lengths(lapply(spots_by_cluster, intersect, y = mbp_high_spots))
)

mean_profiles <- function(barcodes) {
  profiles <- vapply(
    spots_by_cluster,
    function(spots) {
      selected <- intersect(spots, barcodes)
      Matrix::rowMeans(sct_residuals[, selected, drop = FALSE])
    },
    numeric(nrow(sct_residuals))
  )
  rownames(profiles) <- rownames(sct_residuals)
  profiles
}

all_profiles <- mean_profiles(colnames(sct_residuals))
high_profiles <- mean_profiles(mbp_high_spots)
held_out <- !rownames(all_profiles) %in% myelin_genes

pairwise_rho <- function(profiles) {
  rho <- cor(profiles, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  c(
    "12 vs 1" = rho["12", "1"],
    "12 vs 14" = rho["12", "14"],
    "1 vs 14" = rho["1", "14"]
  )
}

round(rbind(
  "All spots" = pairwise_rho(all_profiles),
  "All spots excluding myelin markers" = pairwise_rho(all_profiles[held_out, ]),
  "MBP-high spots" = pairwise_rho(high_profiles),
  "MBP-high spots excluding myelin markers" = pairwise_rho(high_profiles[held_out, ])
), 3)
```


```{r}
# Find shared positive residuals and genes ranked differently in cluster 12.
gene_profiles <- tibble::tibble(
  gene = rownames(all_profiles),
  C1 = all_profiles[, "1"],
  C14 = all_profiles[, "14"],
  C12 = all_profiles[, "12"],
  shared_residual = pmin(C1, C14, C12),
  rank_shift_vs_1 = rank(C12) - rank(C1),
  rank_shift_vs_14 = rank(C12) - rank(C14)
)

shared_genes <- gene_profiles %>%
  filter(shared_residual > 0) %>%
  slice_max(shared_residual, n = 8, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene, C1, C14, C12)

shifted_12 <- gene_profiles %>%
  filter(rank_shift_vs_1 * rank_shift_vs_14 > 0) %>%
  mutate(rank_shift = pmin(abs(rank_shift_vs_1), abs(rank_shift_vs_14))) %>%
  slice_max(rank_shift, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  select(gene, C1, C14, C12, rank_shift_vs_1, rank_shift_vs_14)

shared_genes
shifted_12
```


```{r cluster-12-comparison, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=7, fig.align="center"}
genes_to_plot <- unique(c(
  intersect(myelin_genes, rownames(all_profiles)),
  shared_genes$gene,
  shifted_12$gene
))

heatmap_values <- all_profiles[genes_to_plot, , drop = FALSE]
colour_limit <- max(abs(heatmap_values))

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  heatmap_values,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = paste("Cluster", clusters),
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#313695", "#F7F7F7", "#A50026"))(101),
  breaks = seq(-colour_limit, colour_limit, length.out = 102),
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Shared and shifted genes in cluster 12"
)
```

# Interpretation

## Collagen and hypoxia on the tissue section

Clusters 5 and 9 showed elevated collagen-gene expression and their mean SCT residual profiles had a Spearman correlation of 0.571. The hypoxia marker score was high in areas overlapping cluster 7. These maps locate collagen- and hypoxia-associated transcriptional patterns within the same GBM section.

## Comparing MBP-rich clusters 1, 14 and 12

Among the spots meeting the section-wide *MBP* cutoff, the median *PLP1/MOG/MOBP* module scores were 2.13, 2.14 and 2.13 in clusters 1, 14 and 12, respectively. Across all spots, the cluster-average SCT profiles of clusters 1 and 14 were highly similar (Spearman ρ = 0.944). Cluster 12 was moderately correlated with cluster 1 (ρ = 0.457) and cluster 14 (ρ = 0.434). These relationships persisted in the *MBP*-high subset and after excluding the four myelin markers from the correlation.

Cluster 12 had lower mean SCT residuals for myeloid and complement-associated genes such as *CD163*, *C1QA* and *VSIG4*. Its higher *KIF5A* signal is compatible with a neuronal contribution. These patterns could reflect differences in cell composition or expression state across the spots. [Myeloid programmes in human glioma](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-08633-8) · [KIF5A and axonal transport](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11418931/)

The marker scores and correlations describe spatial associations in one section from an established GBM. Assessing malignant-cell content would require additional evidence such as reviewed histology and tumour-associated copy-number profiles.
